Container.Name: BanditBox
Container.Overview:
Master sync server for the BanditBox Android TV launcher. Edit every TV's profiles and layouts from a web UI; TVs keep working when the server is off. Lightweight: a single Go binary using about 20 MB of RAM.
First start: open the container's log and copy the setup code, then open the WebUI and create the admin account.
Network: "host" (the default here) lets TVs find the server automatically. With "bridge", TVs can still connect but you type the server's address on the TV. With br0 (a custom IP), discovery works too.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port for the web UI and the TV API. With host networking, change BANDITBOX_ADDR instead.

Config.Name: Listen address
Config.Description: Address and port the server listens on inside the container.

Config.Name: Server name
Config.Description: Name TVs see when they find the server.

Config.Name: Advertise port
Config.Description: Only for bridge networking with a different host port: the port TVs should use.

Config.Name: Discovery (mDNS)
Config.Description: Advertise the server on the LAN as _banditbox._tcp.
